ideas.pitch: An automated intelligence-gathering pipeline tailored for OSINT-heavy CTF challenges, leveraging graph intelligence to link fragmented clues, social profiles, and geolocation metadata instantly.
ideas.title: CTF-Forge OSINT Automation Kit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the OSINT track with high technical execution by automating the tedious manual correlation steps required in competitive CTF puzzles.

ideas.pitch: A forensic toolkit that uses neural network classification and LSB (Least Significant Bit) statistical analysis to instantly detect and extract hidden payloads from images and audio files.
ideas.title: StegoGuard: AI-Driven Steganography Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses both Steganography and Digital Forensics domains by automating advanced detection algorithms that typically take hours to solve manually.

ideas.pitch: A localized LLM-powered binary analysis wrapper integrated with Ghidra and IDA Pro outputs to rapidly deobfuscate custom packing, spot cryptographic hardcodes, and locate internal CTF flags.
ideas.title: BinAudit: Automated Reverse Engineering Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on the Reverse Engineering domain by offering a specialized security assistant hardened against hallucinations and focused strictly on binary disassembly.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web workbench for solving advanced Cryptography CTF challenges, featuring automated cipher identification, custom RSA parameter cracking, and frequency analysis utilities.
ideas.title: CryptoCracker Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a comprehensive toolset for the Cryptography domain, saving competitors critical time during high-pressure live scoring rushes.

ideas.pitch: A rapid memory dump parsing engine that parses Volatility profiles against raw RAM images to surface injected DLLs, unlinked processes, and plaintext flags hidden in volatile system state.
ideas.title: MemoryScope Forensics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the Digital Forensics domain by pairing low-level kernel artifact parsing with an intuitive web dashboard for rapid visual verification.
